_comment: Golden reset manifest for the 26 streamhost input-regression tiles plus the 4 emulator-bridge retro tiles (c64/atarist/apple2/amiga; on those, mouse/keyboard 'UNVERIFIED' = input verdicts not yet pixel-certified). Keyed by osId (the SPA ?streamhost=<osId> id, the /signal/<osId>.json key, and the /restore/<osId> path segment). resetMode=loadvm restores the in-qcow2 live `golden` snapshot via QMP (fast, no restart, RAM+devices exact); resetMode=restart cold-boots the tile's curated fixture by re-running qemu-streamhost.sh + restarting streamhost@ (for tiles whose backing store cannot hold a vmstate snapshot). NON-DESTRUCTIVE: reset only restores/relaunches, it never runs savevm. mouse/keyboard = the visually-certified per-input verdict (PASS = a reaction was pixel-verified on the guest's QMP framebuffer by an agent reading before/after PNGs; SKIP = input IS delivered over the open control channel but a documented guest limitation prevents pixel-verification off the captured VGA framebuffer).

pdp11.fixture: 2.11BSD's own multiuser `login:` prompt on a simulated PDP-11/70, with the tail of the machine's unattended cold boot above it and the banner "2.11 BSD UNIX (pdp11) (console)" naming the system; green phosphor, 80x24 xterm on a 1024x768 X root. Baked from an UNTOUCHED cold boot — nothing is typed into the golden and nothing is typed after the restore. A logged-in root shell was rejected as the fixture: it is a state a human typed into, it hides that this is a multiuser timesharing system, and it would hand each visitor whatever the last one left running. Route certified 2026-08-09 AFTER the bake, against the restored fixture, in framebuffer-asserted steps: `root` with no password reaches a shell, `uname -a` prints the 2.11BSD #19 kernel banner and `ls /usr/src` lists the source tree, with no lost characters at 40 ms/40 ms. gt40.fixture: The first seconds of a fresh lunar descent — the LEM in the upper left with its engine firing, ~18000 feet, a full tank, the 75% throttle bar and the twelve-item telemetry menu down the right edge — in Open SIMH's VT11 at crt=vr17 scale=1 hspace=narrow, a 1024x1024 window centred on a 1280x1024 X root. The program restarts itself after each crash, so the bake rides that loop: scripts/build-guests/tiles/gt40.sh waits for the "NO SURVIVORS" message and then for the restart it triggers, which is why reset always hands a visitor a NEW GAME rather than the middle of somebody else's doomed trajectory. Light-pen route certified 2026-08-09 after the bake, by framebuffer: with the pointer parked the menu column is dead still (blink range 0 over 20 samples), a pen touch on ANGLE makes that item blink (range 376 — the program's own acknowledgement that the pen hit a vector), and loadvm golden clears the selection again (range 0). Pointer-only exhibit; no keyboard input of any kind; AC97 card present for device-set parity, but the GT40 is silent.
